title: Liouville theorems for nonlocal Lane--Emden inequalities with degenerate kernels
summary: We establish a Liouville-type theorem for the inequality $\mathcal{L}_K u \ge |u|^q$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$, where $\mathcal{L}_K$ is a translation-invariant, degenerate elliptic integro-differential operator whose kernel is even and satisfies $0\le K(z)\le Λ|z|^{-n-2s}$. No lower ellipticity bound is imposed on the kernel, and no sign condition is imposed on the solution. We prove that every such solution is trivial when $1 \le q \le \frac{n}{n-2s}$ if $n > 2s$, and for every $q \ge 1$ if $n \le 2s$.
